column1: # The bus's ticket punch (označovač) close-up, the user 4. 11.: "the ticket's thump is weirdly AI-sloppy (mainly the sounds)": three takes, the best one goes to assets/sfx/bus/ticket_punch.mp3.

column4: An old orange metal bus ticket validator on a pole inside a 1980s bus: a paper ticket pushed into its slot and the spring-loaded punch slamming down once, a single sharp metallic clack-chunk with a short mechanical rattle, close, dry, no voices, no music.
A heavy mechanical ticket punch on a pole stamping a paper ticket: one hard metal ka-chunk of its spring mechanism and a tiny paper rustle, close, dry, no reverb, no voices, no music.
A vintage manual ticket canceller clicking once as a thin paper ticket is pressed into it: a crisp loud metal clunk and the clatter of its lever springing back, close, no voices, no music.
